title: hetzner/servers/name.json manifests validate against the shipped JSON Schema
asA: developer whose project holds Hetzner server declarations in git
iWant: every hetzner/servers/name.json file to validate against a shipped draft-07 JSON Schema naming type, location, image, sshKeyIds, firewallId, networkId, cloudInitPath, labels, firewallRules and snapshotCadence
soThat: the operator has a stable declarative source of truth and manifest defects surface locally before they reach the API

acceptanceCriteria.description: manifest-schema-validate.mjs asserts every hetzner/servers/*.json under the shared throwaway-server fixture validates against blueprints/deploy-hetzner-server/contributions/schemas/hetzner-server.schema.json and carries every required field; a mutation SIMULATE_MANIFEST_INVALID=true replaces location with an unknown token and the probe FAILS naming the offending field.

Malformed manifest refusal. Given a hetzner/servers/*.json file with a required field missing (for example serverType omitted), when the schema validator runs, then the probe FAILS with a message that names the offending file and the missing required field; the provisioner facade refuses to apply the manifest.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a hetzner/servers/*.json with a required field omitted
acceptanceCriteria.when: manifest-schema-validate.mjs runs against the fixture set
acceptanceCriteria.then: the probe FAILS naming the offending file and the missing required field; the provisioner refuses to apply

acceptanceCriteria.description: Boundary refusal: firewall rule opens ssh to 0.0.0.0/0. Given a manifest whose firewallRules ssh entry carries sourceIps including 0.0.0.0/0, when the schema validator runs, then the probe FAILS naming the ssh rule with the specific 0.0.0.0/0 offence; the provisioner refuses to apply.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a manifest whose firewallRules ssh entry carries sourceIps including 0.0.0.0/0
acceptanceCriteria.then: the probe FAILS naming the ssh rule and the 0.0.0.0/0 offence; the provisioner refuses to apply
